_about: The 15 MVP placements (docs/modes/conversations-design.md §7 and §9.1) as data. A mode calls Conversations.maybe({placement: id, ...}) (or Conversations.run(id, ...) for scripted story beats: no caps). slot: before | during | after. speakers: who may ask (roster ids or a role the host fills: 'customer', 'patient'). exchanges: tried in order (the first that fits wins; 'firstMeetingOnly' ones need the speaker's first meeting today). chain: exchanges played one after another (only the first is graded; the rest are 'must get right' but untracked). scripted: the story runs it (Conversations.run). heard: lines said with no reply (Kasuku only ever repeats, §10a.10). stages: the syllabus stages it's offered in. relaxedOnly: refused in Busy. alias: a row that stands for other rows. Hook points for each are in docs/modes/conversations-wiring.md.
